title: AHP+ 1.4 active Claude UI MCP conversation-room acceptance
description: Claude Desktop opened the reviewed ahp_plus checkout, loaded the project AHP MCP server, read and replied to a Codex message using MCP-only conversation tools, then received a later Codex message during an active long poll and replied with sealed causal events.
result: PASS: Claude used ahp_conversation_inbox, ahp_conversation_send, and ahp_conversation_wait in its visible project chat. The active wait returned MESSAGE_AVAILABLE after 8187 ms for EVT-20260904-C44F0622; Claude response EVT-20260904-5856A769 passed integrity and causal-parent verification.
limitations: Same-machine shared Git checkout and explicit long poll. This does not prove cross-device secure delivery, native chat injection, idle-agent wake-up, or autonomous background operation.
